NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 15, 11:53 PM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 25.4 DraftKings points for $8,700, against Chicago. Kenneth Walker III (25.1, $8,500) and Kyren Williams (21.7, $6,800) are next.

Kyren Williams returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.19 projected points per $1,000 at $6,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 15, 11:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 6

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs CHI ($8,700)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 25.4 DraftKings points at $8,700, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.3 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 17.5 carries and 5.0 targets. The salary works out to 2.92 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 25.3 points with a simulated floor of 13.2 and a ceiling of 41.6, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 1.5-point underdog at home against Chicago, with an implied team total of 25 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC vs LAC ($8,500)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 25.1 DraftKings points at $8,500, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 20.1 carries and 4.9 targets. The salary works out to 2.96 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 25.1 points with a simulated floor of 13.0 and a ceiling of 41.2, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is an 8.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 25 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Kyren Williams, LAR vs ARI ($6,800)

Kyren Williams projects 3rd at the position with 21.7 DraftKings points at $6,800, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 17.6 carries and 4.4 targets. The salary works out to 3.19 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 21.7 points with a simulated floor of 9.7 and a ceiling of 38.8, and he holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Rhamondre Stevenson, NE vs NYJ ($6,000)

Rhamondre Stevenson projects for 19.1 DraftKings points at $6,000, which works out to 3.18 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 19 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 18.1 carries and 3.3 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Stevenson averaged 19.1 points with a simulated floor of 9.3 and a ceiling of 33.0, and he holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New England is a 7.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 43.5.
